speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly where the rash started and how it has spread over time? Also, have you noticed any changes in your nails or experienced joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of working with livestock and rice, have you had any recent travel to endemic areas or noticed any skin lesions that look like open sores or ulcers? I need to rule out parasitic or bacterial infections like leishmaniasis or sparganosis.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your pruritic rash, hypopigmented macules, and specifically the loss of eyebrows and eyelashes is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease (Leprosy). To confirm this, I need to assess your nerve function more closely; can you feel the temperature difference between a cold and warm object on your palms, and have you noticed any thickening of your peripheral nerves?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The thickening of peripheral nerves combined with loss of eyebrows and eyelashes strongly points to leprosy. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy
